data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order startup context.** Constructing every plugin before any start hook means later factories cannot observe context installed by earlier plugins. Both OTel factories now extract context, read `Span.current()`, and start the Invocation span during construction, so a preceding initializer plugin can leave telemetry disabled or incorrectly parented. Interleave factory creation with its start hook, or defer OTel’s context-sensitive initialization to `onInvocationStart` with safe publication; update the ordering test accordingly.
